status: Retained required-bounds and native candidate repair: final DRC/consumer validation, capability cost gates and full-fixture content audit pass. The complete properties.md goal remains active.
scope: Required native Polygon bounds/center/dimension failures and conservative native layer-polygon candidate selection.

baseline.result: Fourteen reproduced failures on the recorded unchanged production revision. Existing PcbRegion bounds and two coarse-ring candidate controls already pass; they are not counted as repaired failures.

contract: Polygon::try_bounds returns Result<Option<[Scalar;4]>> under STRICT. Only certified empty geometry returns None. Retained source failures, unknown bounds and already-exhausted shared scopes remain errors, including warm values; only completed values populate the shared success cache.

Required aperture, stencil, text-height, skinny/sliver, duplicate-layer and density preparation paths propagate missing bounds to geometry-uncertainty findings. Tombstone pad-center construction is checked. Choosing a minimum envelope dimension requires a certified comparison.

Text-height marker construction forms its center in native arithmetic before checked finite report projection, avoiding overflow of a finite native center. Other optional markers may use diagnostic report bounds, and missing optional markers cannot erase a proved finding.

LayerPolygonSpatialIndex uses certified outward native envelopes. Each envelope occupies every cell between its endpoint keys, with a 256-cell scheduling cap. Unknown, unrepresentable and oversized boxes retain fallback candidates; unknown or oversized queries retain all indices. Queries are sorted and deduplicated.

The monotone endpoint-to-cell mapping preserves closed envelope contacts even if division rounds or integer keys saturate. Positive radius expansion rounds outward; nonfinite radii or expanded endpoints disable culling. Report-ring bounds never reject these candidates.

Duplicate-island detection no longer groups by quantized report area/bounds. The native grid proposes pairs and existing required native area/intersection predicates decide them. Identical circles with 17 and 128 report samples now report the same duplicate.

Whole-layer duplicate bounds come from the native regularized region. Native pair envelope filters cull only certified separating axes; missing bounds, unknown comparisons or unavailable radius projections retain candidates.
Readiness implementation version is 7; schema remains 1. Six Easyduino snapshots change only version fields, preserving finding rows, counts and evidence IDs.

consumer_validation.scope: Six Easyduino fast-DRC board snapshots, one impedance unit and two smoke tests selected by hyperdrc, plus five curved-outline tests. This is not the full HyperCircuit suite.

cost.limitations: Five sequential fresh processes and one unchanged full two-board/Gerber fixture run pinned to CPU 0 after builds/tests exit. The first 24 rows repeat the preceding area/operation witnesses and iteration counts byte-for-byte. Their existing query, construction, report and coverage scopes are retained. New warm Polygon bounds rows query existing native circles with 17 and 1,000,000 report samples; source construction, first/last exact area and report fingerprints are outside timers. Construction rows include new circle construction, report samples, first bounds evaluation and drop, for 17/128 samples. Empty and unknown rows query existing owners. Duplicate rows time the complete check, including index construction and exact predicates: two identical native circles with 17/128 report samples, and 1,003 sparse rectangles with one triple duplicate. First/last area, report fingerprints and expected finding/location checks are outside timers but inside RSS. Internal kernel evidence may be warm. All 32 witness rows must be identical across all trials. These are capability costs without a matched speedup, allocation count or library-size claim. The million-sample report fixture is included in whole-process RSS; the fixture workload and its 120-second gate are unchanged.
